bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'ACTION=COLLECTOR_LIVE_DIAGNOSTIC\n'
printf 'USERBOT_SERVICE=%s\n' "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
printf 'G_MOUNT=%s\n' "$(findmnt -n -o TARGET /mnt/g || true)"
printf 'COLLECTOR_UNITS\n'
systemctl --user list-units --all --type=service --no-legend | grep -Ei 'collect|telegram|userbot|video' | cut -c1-160 || true
printf 'COLLECTOR_PROCESSES\n'
ps -eo pid,etimes,args | grep -Ei '(video.*collect|collect.*video|theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV)' | grep -v grep | sed -E 's/(api_id|api_hash|token|password)=[^ ]+/\1=[REDACTED]/Ig' | cut -c1-180 || true
printf 'G_COLLECTION_DIRS\n'
find /mnt/g -maxdepth 5 -type d \( -iname '*nippon*' -o -iname '*telegram*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -30
printf 'END_DIAGNOSTIC\n'
